title: fetch_reference_rates result
description: Euro foreign exchange reference rates of the European Central Bank for one reference date, expressed for the requested base currency.

reference_date.description: The day of the rates, as the European Central Bank gives it.

rates.description: Units of each currency for one unit of the base. A rate between two currencies other than the euro is computed through the euro and rounded half up to 6 decimal places.

stale.description: true when the reference date is more than 4 calendar days before the UTC date of observed_at.

attribution.const: Source: European Central Bank, euro foreign exchange reference rates. The reference rates are published for information purposes only. Using the rates for transaction purposes is strongly discouraged.
